crossRefs.note: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.
“My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury…
As the camels had done drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of…
Solomon made all the vessels that were in Yahweh’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of…
All king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of…
Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the…
Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…
“But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and…
and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and…
that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be…

translations.web: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
translations.bsb: “Surely there is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.
translations.kjv: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine
translations.asv: Surely there is a mine for silver, And a place for gold which they refine.
